Parity details

The ledger's committed parity summary in full: every table behind the Overview's parity figures.

Parity (measured after determinism)

After the determinism checks, the retained verify log of each candidate backend whose inputs can be equalized with the ptrace reference's (kvm, liteinst, sabre, dbt, in-guest-trap) is compared with the ptrace reference log. A cell's credit is the matched prefix of the two logs over the longer one, in [0, 1]; only a complete match earns 1. The parity population is every test whose ptrace verify cell full validation selects, on every candidate backend. A cell whose ptrace reference left no usable golden log is outside it, never 0 credit; every other cell is in it, and a candidate that was not enabled, not selected, failed or left no usable log scores 0. This panel shows the ledger's committed parity summary after checking it against the parity records it summarizes; it is separate from determinism and recomputes no credit. data/parity.json.gz publishes the committed parity carriage, whose summary text is the exact bytes its digest names, and every retained cross-backend witness in the validation history.

Stale: this summary covers the parity store at ledger commit b112a8bf71059b9884a6c488b52f5ec8f4a1b405; 13,850 newer parity record line(s) at ledger commit 4d0c983fea1d19e0a24d698fd982497e88327d69 are not summarized. The figures below are as of b112a8bf71059b9884a6c488b52f5ec8f4a1b405. A parity-only publication appends records without rewriting the summary; the next scorecard publication summarizes them.
